newsitem.title: USA: WorldCom licenses Voxware voice technology.
newsitem.headline: WorldCom licenses Voxware voice technology.

text.p: Voxware Inc Tuesday said that WorldCom Inc has agreed to license two of Voxware's voice compression technologies.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
WorldCom will license RT24 and RT29HQ, two of Voxware's low-bandwidth compression-decompression (codecs) technologies.
The agreement allows both companies to share expertise and technology to research and test future Internet Protocol-based telephony solutions, the company said.
Voxware Inc develops, markets, licenses and supports digital speech processing and audio technologies that compress, model and transform speech.
